title: Strength in Numbers
summary: From funding life-saving research to furthering the advancement of women in the workplace, purpose-led initiatives are at the core of the Estée Lauder Cos. company values.

extraction.key_fact: 에스티 로더 컴퍼니즈는 생명 구조 연구 지원과 직장 내 여성 발전 지원 등 목적 중심 이니셔티브를 기업 가치의 핵심으로 삼고 있다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: From funding life-saving research to furthering the advancement of women in the workplace, purpose-led initiatives are at the core of the Estée Lauder Cos. company values.
